# Reallusion

> > Reallusion provides professional 3D character creation and animation software including iClone, Character Creator, and CrazyTalk for game development, filmmaking, and digital content production.

Reallusion specializes in real-time 3D animation tools with support for major game engines (Unreal Engine, Unity) and 3D software (Maya, Blender). Their flagship products include Character Creator for digital human creation with AccuRIG auto-rigging, iClone for motion capture and animation, and CrazyTalk for facial animation and lip-sync.

## Key Topics

- iClone - Real-time 3D animation software
- Character Creator (CC) - 3D character design and digital human creation
- CrazyTalk - Facial animation and lip-sync software
- AccuRIG - Automatic rigging system
- ActorMIXER - Character customization tool
- Digital Human Shader - Realistic skin and material rendering
- HumanIK - Professional motion retargeting
- PBR materials and Substance 3D integration
- Game-ready assets for Unreal Engine and Unity
- Motion capture and mocap editing
- Audio-driven facial animation and lip-sync
- Auto-rigging for custom characters
- 3D character animation and motion libraries
